sections.title: Wishes About the Past
sections.content: You know *bárcsak* ('if only') from Unit 5. With the past tense + *volna* it expresses strong regret about an unchangeable past event: *Bárcsak jobban figyeltem volna!* ('If only I had paid better attention!').

items.spanish: Bárcsak ne követtem volna el ezt a súlyos mulasztást!
items.english: If only I hadn't committed this grave omission!

items.spanish: Bárcsak hallgattunk volna a szakértő tanácsára!
items.english: If only we had listened to the expert's advice!
